_comment: Format for .opencodereview/rule.json — user-supplied review rules that override or extend system defaults
_first_match_wins: Rules are matched in array order. First matching path wins for that file. Without merge_system_rule, user rule replaces the system rule entirely.

rules.rule: All new methods must validate required parameters for null. Check for missing @NonNull annotations.
Check SQL for injection risks, missing closing tags, and N+1 query patterns.
Extra scrutiny: this package handles payment data. Flag any use of fmt.Sprintf for SQL construction.
